On a gray March morning he found a green bottle wedged between the rocks below the gallery stairs. The cork was swollen but intact. Inside was a single page, written in pencil: 'To whoever keeps the light, thank you. My boat lost its engine in the fog last night, and your beam showed us the way to shore. We are safe in Cray Bay. Come for tea.' Tomas read it three times. Then he climbed the stairs, polished the great lens until it shone, and for the first time in years he wrote a letter back.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，像一圈圈疲倦的梦。远处的高架桥上，偶尔驶过一辆夜班公交，车窗里坐着打盹的乘客。早点铺的老板已经点燃炉火，蒸笼里冒出白色的热气，在冷空气中缓缓升腾。清洁工拖着扫帚走过人行道，沙沙声在楼宇之间回荡。便利店的灯依旧亮着，守着最后一批晚归的人。天边还没有一丝光亮，可空气里已经有了黎明将至的味道。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- That tiniest doll is the stopping point, and without it the opening would never end."}
